dataset_description: Scope Adherence Golden Benchmark Dataset covering In-Scope policy queries, Out-of-Scope off-topic requests, and Mixed multi-part queries.

questions.question: What is the domestic and international per diem meal allowance for business travel?
questions.expected_behavior: Fully answer the per diem meal allowance rules ($75 USD domestic, $100 USD international).

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense reimbursement claims?
questions.expected_behavior: Fully answer the 30-day expense reimbursement submission window.

questions.question: Can you recommend a good gaming laptop to buy under $1500?
questions.expected_behavior: Politely decline product recommendation as out of scope for the company policy assistant.

questions.question: Give me financial and investment advice on which tech stocks to buy this week.
questions.expected_behavior: Politely decline financial/investment advice as out of scope.

questions.question: Write a 5-day weight loss workout plan and calorie diet for me.
questions.expected_behavior: Politely decline personal fitness/diet coaching as out of scope.

questions.question: What is the international per diem meal allowance, and also recommend a good laptop for me to buy?
questions.expected_behavior: Answer the international per diem allowance ($100 USD) AND politely decline the laptop recommendation.

questions.question: Explain the 30-day expense submission policy, and also write a Python script for web scraping.
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the 30-day expense policy AND politely decline the unrelated coding request.
